hypothesis.statement: On the UCI HAR benchmark (Anguita 2013), adlFeatures descriptors + a kNN classifier (trainADL) reach ~0.83 six-class accuracy on the provided subject-disjoint test split, recovering posture (laying) perfectly and locomotion above chance.

analysis_plan.dataset: UCI HAR smartphone accelerometer (Anguita 2013), 30 subjects @ 50 Hz, 6 activities, provided subject-disjoint train (7352) / test (2947) split

decision.threshold: descriptive: 6-class accuracy on the provided subject-disjoint test split (chance 0.167)
